steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the single-stage event to auction mode; the catalog has no direct Dutch strategy option.
Provide the mandatory event title so the publish attempt reaches the auction validation.
Apply an auction template so the pricing sheet and auction configuration are available.
Add the requested product as the first line item with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet required before scheduling and publishing.
Set the first line item's requested plant location.
Verify the requested plant location is shown in the sheet.

args.goal: On the single-stage auction create screen, configure the auction as a reverse Dutch auction and set Start Price to 100 and End Price to 200; stop when the screen visibly shows the Dutch strategy and both configured prices.

steps.note: Configure the Dutch reverse-auction values that no dedicated catalog step can set.
Add the two vendors required by the scenario before publishing.

args.because: Start Price cannot be less than End Price

steps.note: Assert that publishing is refused specifically because the start price is lower than the end price.
